articles.summary: MIDLAND, Texas, Aug. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - New Era Energy Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: NUAI) (“New Era” or the “Company”), a developer of next-generation digital infrastructure and integrated power assets, today announced its support for Texas Governor Greg Abbott’s directive to strengthen oversight of data center development in Texas. The directive calls for greater transparency around data center power and water requirements, infrastructure costs, ownership and community impacts, and reinforces the principle that large-scale development should bring additional energy solutions to Texas rather than shift incremental cost and infrastructure burden onto Texas residents. “New Era welcomes clearer and higher standards for the industry and is fully committed to working with the Governor, regulators, utilities, ERCOT and the local community to ensure the next generation of digital infrastructure is built the right way,” said Charlie Nelson, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of New
